nom: Origins Checks And Balances Milky Oil Cleanser + Makeup Melter

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the cleanser removes makeup without leaving a greasy residue or increasing oiliness, though one warns those with very oily skin may want to avoid an oil-based formula.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as gentle and non-stripping, leaving the face soft, hydrated and comfortable after rinsing.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin found it effective at removing makeup and impurities without leaving skin dry or stripped.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and a clean, smooth after-feel, though others (skin type unspecified) describe stinging or burning around the eyes.

concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product broke her out badly on the nose and cheeks after a single use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts, and one says it even helped with sugar-related breakouts, though this is contradicted by a separate report of a bad breakout after one use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes the oil left the eye area red and swollen after use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say it cleanses without stripping natural oils or over-drying the skin, supporting a comfortable barrier feel.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including ones with dry skin, report skin feels soft, smooth and hydrated rather than stripped after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it does not make their skin feel oilier or greasy after rinsing, though one reviewer suggests avoiding it if skin is very oily.

aspects.libelle: Removes waterproof mascara and eye makeup
Fails to fully remove eye makeup
Stings or burns eyes on contact
Thick, heavy oil texture hard to spread

extraits.texte: I don't have sensitive skin at all, but this oil irritated the skin around my eyes. It was too painful to continue so I quickly washed it off and used my HG oil, which is gentle. I can't say I recommend this because I couldn't even get past the burning to see if it removed my eye makeup.

It removed make up okay. It also did not get the grits out of my pores like a normal pol cleanser does. That i can forgive, but then it broke me out so bad on my nose and cheeks after 1 use. Not a fan.

extraits.titre: Adding it to my skincare routine
extraits.texte: complimentary from Origins I have been extremely impressed with its effectiveness. This product is perfect for those with combination or oily skin, as it effectively removes makeup and impurities without leaving the skin feeling dry or stripped. The cleanser has a creamy texture that feels luxurious on the skin, and it effectively removes all traces of makeup, including stubborn waterproof mascara. I love that it doesn't leave any residue on the skin, and it leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed. One of the things I appreciate about this product is that it contains natural ingredients like lavender, white tea, and rice bran, which help to soothe and nourish the skin. I have noticed that my skin looks brighter and more even-toned since I started using this cleanser. Overall, I would highly recommend the Origins Balances Milky Cleanser and Makeup Remover to anyone looking for an effective and gentle cleanser that can remove makeup and impurities without stripping the skin. It's a great addition to any skincare routine, and I will definitely be purchasing it in the future.

I LOVE this cleanser! I was skeptical to use an oil cleanser because I have oily and acne prone skin but I was pleasantly surprised by this. It does a great job of removing make up and what not and didn't leave my skin feeling greasy. I was gifted by Origins US.

I love this cleanser gifted by Origins! I have very sensitive skin so I'm picky with what skincare products I use. This removes all the gunk effectively and makes my skin feel so clean and smooth. I also haven't broke out at all since using this!

extraits.titre: Great if you're into full glam!
extraits.texte: Amazing makeup dissolver!!! I have very sentive and dry skin, i also really dislike when soaps/oil irritate my eyes so this one is my tried-and-true. I wear full glam makeup everyday for work so ill shake a few drops of this product onto a cloth (like micellar water) and remove as much makeup as i can, and its easy with this stuff. Ill then go in with Lancôme's creme wash to remove the rest. Takes off absolutely everything, even stubborn eyelash glue! Definitely have added this one to my routine.

I was gifted by Origins US and am obsessed! It truly melts your makeup away after a long day! It's oil based so if you have super oily skin I would maybe stay away. A little bit will go a long way so you definitely get your moneys worth! Highly recommend trying it out!
